title: Chapter 939
text:
Over the next few days, Fu Ding and Aurora cooperated with Raymond to search for traces of the Blood Hammer Church in the various cities of Enya Hub. This matter had already been reported to the police force, and after some questioning, they promised to investigate the traces of suspicious individuals before sending them out. Clearly, they had no intention of getting the superheroes to help.

While the status of superheroes in the universe had already been legalized, the police force did not like to work with superheroes. After all, they were not ordinary people. Most superheroes were only Grade B Supers, and there were plenty of Grade B Supers who worked for the various civilizations. Those superheroes with fancy nicknames might not necessarily be a match for ordinary officers in a real fight, so most of the time, there was no need for the so-called superheroes to help.

Raymond insisted on searching for traces of the Blood Hammer Church, and Fu Ding remembered the mission that Han Xiao had given him. He stayed in the stronghold that Raymond had rented and hid his strength to help.

After a few days, the three of them still did not find any traces of the Blood Hammer Church, but the reinforcements of the Punisher Alliance arrived.

"You guys are finally here!"

In the stronghold, Raymond was overjoyed and welcomed the reinforcements. After exchanging a few pleasantries, he introduced his companions to Feidin and the others. Everyone looked at Feidin and Aurora. Most of them had a friendly expression and nodded in greeting. However, a small portion of them were expressionless and did not do anything.

"These two are Chen Xing and Euler. They are both Grade B Supers, especially Euler. Her healing Esper ability is just too amazing."

"Hello, I am Chen Xing." Fu Ding smiled and greeted everyone. He did not have the arrogance of a Calamity Grade Super, and his temperament was extremely amiable.

It would have been fine if he did not smile, but the moment he smiled, many of the people present felt their hearts race.

Fudin's charm was irrespective of race and gender, and his every move unconsciously exuded a special attraction. If he still smiled, it would really kill people. Even if he wore a disguised face, it could not hide his volcanic eruption of charm.

This new comrade's temperament is really good … many people muttered and looked at each other.

"I'm O … Aurora." Aurora was not used to her fake name.

Everyone looked over, and their gazes immediately became much more fervent. Who wouldn't like a companion with healing abilities? Who knew when they would need his help?

Just as he was about to step forward and make new friends, a discordant voice rang out from the crowd.

"I would like to ask, why did you join the Punisher Alliance?"

Everyone looked at the source of the voice with a helpless expression. The one who spoke was Selly, who was very cautious.

"Because he invited us." Aurora shrugged and pointed at Raymond.

"You guys are also Grade B Supers. Don't you think it's strange that you joined us just because of a simple invitation? You haven't even heard of the name of the Punisher Alliance before, and you've just changed your mind on the spot? Oh, I'd rather believe that you've been premeditated. "Selly's tone was cold. Everything was too coincidental. He couldn't help but doubt.

Fu Ding smiled and did not argue. Everyone was worried that he would be dissatisfied, so they hurriedly came up to dissuade him. Just now, Fu Ding gave them a good first impression, so they could not help but speak up for him.

He's so handsome, so he's obviously a good person!

Selly's eyes twitched, and he barely managed to resist Fu Ding's Charm Halo. He walked past Fu Ding and stared at Fu Ding. "I will keep an eye on you. If you have any other intentions, don't blame me for being impolite."

Then, he walked away with large strides.

Because of Selly's actions, the atmosphere became a little awkward. At this moment, Raymond walked up and patted Fu Ding's shoulder. "Don't bother about him. He has always been like that. When I first joined, I was also targeted by him."

"It's fine." Fu Ding smiled.

Seeing this, the others also came up to chat. Fu Ding dealt with them with ease and quickly blended into the group. It was not difficult for him at all.

After resting for half a day, the captain of this temporary hero team gathered everyone and gave them the mission to search for the Blood Hammer Church.

The Punisher Alliance did not have many people, so only a few people were in charge of a large area and slowly searched for clues.

Fu Ding and Aurora naturally stayed together and followed Raymond. With the addition of a Pugilist hero, the four of them were in a small group and searched for a rather bustling city in Enya Hub.

…

The artificial sun gradually set, and the blood-red sunset dyed the sky red. As the sun slowly retreated to the horizon, night slowly covered the sky, and the bright lights of Enya Hub gradually lit up. Enya Hub only woke up at night, showing the other side of this galactic metropolis. It was as though a traveler carrying a suitcase had turned into a sexy lady with heavy makeup and seductive eyes.

The night was the curtain of the entertainment field. There were travelers and goods from various Star Systems here, and countless people were indulging in a life of luxury. When dawn arrived, they would continue on their journey.

The crowd on the streets was denser than during the day. The crowd was surging, and the air was filled with an impetuous and joyful atmosphere. It was like alcohol mixed with freshly squeezed fruit juice. It was choking, but it had a fresh and sweet taste.

Fu Ding's group of four walked on the streets and looked around. Raymond pushed a drunk bugman away and said in a low voice, "The Blood Hammer Church usually performs blood rituals.

Everyone, pay attention and don't ignore the smell of blood. Pay more attention to the more secluded areas. "

Fu Ding did not reply. After walking for a while, Aurora suddenly tugged on Fu Ding's sleeve and pointed to the sky.

"There's a Calamity Grade life signal."

Fu Ding raised his head and saw a flying vehicle flying over from afar. It stopped at the top of a tall building, and a group of bodyguards surrounded a young man. Two of the bodyguards were emitting the aura of a Calamity Grade.

The passersby also noticed this aura and looked over. Raymond glanced over and muttered, "That seems to be an important figure."

The Pugilist beside him shook his head and said, "In any case, we won't be able to come into contact with such a figure. Don't look. It has nothing to do with us."

"That's true."

Ignoring the two beside him, Feidin realized that the two Calamity Grade bodyguards looked a little familiar, as though he had seen their pictures somewhere before. He had always trusted his instincts, and seeing that the two of them were talking to each other and not paying attention to him, he took out his communicator and sent the image he had just seen into the communicator through his memory.

"Philip, find out who these people are."

"Okay, hum … Comparing with database … Comparison complete. Match found."

The large artificial intelligence database of the Black Star Corps was also open to ordinary people, and most of them were subprograms of Philip. As someone who had followed Han Xiao for a long time, Fu Ding had the authority to enjoy the functions of Philip's main artificial intelligence. Compared to ordinary members, the difference was about 3G and 5G.

Lowering his head to take a look, Fu Ding's eyes flickered. Philip's database contained the information of all the officials and officers of the Red Empire, and he discovered that the two Calamity Grade bodyguards were Supers of the Red Empire. As for the young man who was being escorted, there was no detailed information about him. It was obvious that there was some unknown power protecting him. Those who had such treatment were usually the relatives of the upper echelons of the Red Empire.

"He should be the descendant of one of the dynasty's upper echelons."

Feidin nodded, not caring. However, at this moment, Aurora, who was close by, sent him a message.

"I've sensed that there are four more Calamity Grade Supers hiding in different locations nearby."

Aurora's life force detection was a convenient method to find people. If it wasn't for a spatial isolation ability like a boundary magic, normal concealment and disguise would be useless in front of Aurora. She could easily sense the life force of others and judge the other party's combat strength.

Fu Ding's footsteps paused, and he looked at the location that Aurora had marked out. He realized that the four unknown Calamity Grade Supers had surrounded the area. He did not know if they were protecting the descendant of the dynasty's upper echelon or if they had other motives.

"Hmm … it has nothing to do with us. Don't bother about it first."

Although Feidin said this, he kept a lookout in his heart. He had a bad feeling that something was going to happen tonight.

After searching for a while, the few of them walked out of the busiest area, and Raymond suddenly received a message from his comrade.

"Come over quickly. We have already found the Blood Hammer Church!" His comrade sounded anxious, and there were sounds of battle in the background.

"Where are you guys? Have you already started fighting with the Blood Hammer Church?" Raymond asked anxiously.

"No, it's not us." His comrade's tone suddenly became strange, and he could not understand what was going on. "It's not us who found the Blood Hammer Church, but them … they are actually attacking the restricted military zone!"

"What?" The few of them were stunned.

In their impression, the Blood Hammer Church was a bunch of fanatics who secretly captured people as blood sacrifices. Why would they attack a restricted military zone?

All of a sudden, they had a bad premonition.

Right at this moment, they realized that the ground beneath their feet seemed to be trembling.

Boom!

A burst of dazzling light came from the distance, and dazzling pillars of light rose from several districts in the distance. The flames lit up the night sky, and it was incomparably eye-catching.

The shockwave swept over like a hurricane. Even though they were in the same area, they were still affected by the shockwave, and their hair danced wildly in the wind.

As the flames rose into the sky, countless passersby were stunned, and they turned around to look at the location of the explosion.

"Something's wrong!"

Fu Ding frowned.

This was Enya Hub, which was heavily guarded. Such a huge commotion could not have been caused by a second-rate organization like the Blood Hammer Church.

I was misled by Raymond's guess. The Blood Hammer Church might not be the only one causing trouble in Enya Hub. They might have bigger plans.

The moment this thought flashed through his mind, an ear-piercing alarm sounded throughout the city, and battleships were activated one after another, heading toward the explosion zone.

The next second, the passersby were thrown into chaos.

…

Bang!

The warhammer slashed through the air and smashed the head of one of the Supers guarding Enya Hub, causing blood to spurt everywhere.

The Blood Hammer Bishop led a large group of Blood Hammer Priests to a corner of the restricted military zone, exchanging fire with the soldiers stationed there.

The Supers were killing each other, and the defense turrets and mechanical vehicles in the surroundings fired crazily at the members of the Blood Hammer Church. Beams of dark energy bombarded the magic shields of the Blood Hammer Priests, and the Blood Hammer Priests were constantly annihilated, not even leaving behind dust.

In this battlefield, the Blood Hammer Bishop was unstoppable and displayed the strength of a Calamity Grade. He charged left and right, and anything that stood in his way was destroyed with a single swing of his warhammer. The high-level combatants of Enya Hub would not be stationed at all times, and reinforcements were still on the way.

Bishop Blood Hammer held his hammer with both hands and slammed it on the ground. Strange red magic runes lit up on the hammer and his body. The blood on the ground seemed to evaporate, turning into a large cloud of blood mist. It condensed in the air and formed a huge figure. Only the upper half of the body was strange. A violent energy seemed to be transmitted from the void and lodged in this cloud of red mist.

The next moment, two sun-like balls of light lit up on the face of the ball of red mist, as though they were eyes. A certain consciousness had descended.

Violent magic energy surged out of its body, and bright red magic arrows shot out from its body, attacking indiscriminately on the battlefield. If the arrows hit the Blood Hammer Priests, the Blood Hammer Priests would turn red as though they had been given a buff. Not only would their injuries heal, but their combat strength would also increase. If the arrows hit the enemies, small snakes would appear under the skin of the enemies, and the blood in their bodies would flow backward.

This figure was the 'God' of the Blood Hammer Church, a High Dimension Magic Entity. It had descended temporarily through a special method and had the strength of a Calamity Grade. Together with the Blood Hammer Bishop himself, this battlefield was equivalent to being attacked by two Calamity Grades.

In the other directions of this restricted military zone, intense explosions also occurred. The Blood Hammer Church was not the only organization attacking the restricted military zone. This was a premeditated cooperation!

…

The tallest building in the center of Enya Hub was the property of the protector of this place. The person guarding this place was a senior Calamity Grade Super under the command of a Beyond Grade A named Jabra.

Seeing the flames in the city from the window, Jabra threw away the female creature in his hands and stood in front of the window, looking at the area of the explosion with a frown.

"Your Excellency Jabra, there's an emergency!" The deputy's remote projection appeared in the room, and he did not even look at the trembling woman wrapped in the blanket beside him. With a hurried tone, he quickly explained the situation.

"Someone attacked the military zone where the Evolutionary Totem is located? You dare to steal from my territory? You're courting death! "

Jabra's face was filled with killing intent, and he casually put on his pants. Following which, he kicked the window and jumped into the night sky. His entire body ignited with a blazing gray Pugilist flame, and he turned into a meteor that tore through the night sky, falling toward the battlefield.

At the same time, in the city where Feidin and the others were, a Calamity-Grade wanted criminal hiding in the dark saw the gray meteor in the sky. He pressed his short-range earpiece and whispered, "That's right.

"Jabra has already been lured away, and the other Calamity Grade Supers are also rushing to the battlefield. The organizations over there will delay these Calamity Grade Supers, and when the chaos engulfs the entire city, we can take action. Remember, we have to end the battle quickly and pretend that it was an accident."

…

At the same time, in another part of Enya Hub that was not affected by the explosion, two ordinary-looking men stood on the top floor of a tall building and looked down at the chaos and flames. One of them was the one who had been monitoring the spaceport a few days ago.

"The operation has begun."

"Thank you for proving that I'm not blind."

"I wonder how many of these gray forces hired by the black market will survive tonight."

"Ah, even if they survive the night, they'll be eliminated sooner or later. They'll either be killed by us or judged by the dynasty."

"The garrison troops have already rushed over to protect the Evolutionary Totem. Heh, do they really think that they spent so much effort just for a mere Evolutionary Totem?"

"Thankfully, this is not a colonial planet of the dynasty. If not, they would not have been able to smuggle in all sorts of prohibited weapons. The other teams will have enough time to spread the chaos throughout the city. The more places they blow up, the better."

"The person guarding this planet is the right-hand man of a Beyond Grade A Super. This chaos will probably be suppressed before the sun rises. Humph, spending so many resources in exchange for a night of chaos."

"It doesn't matter. It doesn't matter if these gray organizations die. As long as the other team kills the target, it will be enough. Only then will we be able to report to the team leader."

"It's really dangerous to be assigned such a mission. Tsk, I'm really envious of the other teams …"

The fierce wind cut their conversation into pieces.
